dedupe_keys.name: ideas integrated district energy assessment simulations

description: IDEAS (Integrated District Energy Assessment Simulations) is a free and open-source Modelica library for simultaneous transient simulation of integrated thermal and electrical energy systems, including buildings at individual and district level, with a particular focus on detailed building models. It was originally developed by KU Leuven and the consultancy 3E and is now maintained by the Thermal Systems Simulation research group of KU Leuven, with contributions from UGent, IBPSA Project 1 and IEA EBC Annex 60. It extends the Modelica IBPSA Library and is one of four sister libraries alongside AixLib, Modelica Buildings and BuildingSystems. Coverage is generic. It is distributed as Modelica source on GitHub; release 4.0.0 was tagged in September 2025. Licence: BSD 3-clause from KU Leuven and 3E, free of charge. Caveat: detailed envelope models are computationally heavier than reduced-order alternatives, and a Modelica environment is required. Simulation uses are building and district energy system sizing and the coupled thermal and electrical network flow of neighbourhoods. Related records: Modelica IBPSA Library (its core), AixLib, Modelica Buildings Library and BuildingSystems (sister libraries), TEASER (model generator).
